item.title: BreakingNews Reports indicate a sharp depreciation in the Sinaloa real estate market
item.description: The real estate market is experiencing a sharp decline in the state. In Culiacán, property values ​​have depreciated by up to 40%, primarily due to the context of violence, while in Mazatlán the drop is around 20%, also influenced by an oversupply of high-rise housing and a demand that hasn’t kept pace. item.description: The MEGA conference might just become a defining moment for the gaming sector across Latin America. item.title: In 2025, 715 sea turtle nests were rescued in Mazatlán.
item.description: During 2025, 715 sea turtle nests were rescued on Mazatlán’s beaches as part of a protection program operating along a 16-kilometer stretch of coastline. This stretch extends from Cerritos Beach to Olas Altas. item.description: During the Christmas and New Year’s celebrations, Sinaloa Civil Protection responded to a total of 19 incidents in various municipalities throughout the state, most of them related to traffic accidents and vehicles running off the road, reported the agency’s director, Roy Navarrete Cuevas.
